title: Chain Analysis
subtitle: Follow physical flows. Inspect evidence. Keep hypotheses visible.
scopeError: The active book could not be verified.
subject: Starting point
subjectPlaceholder: Transaction ID, outpoint, address, wallet ID — or leave empty for overview
observerHelp: Perspective is a projection of locally available evidence. Missing observations remain missing; this view does not query a provider.
emptyDetail: Choose a transaction, output, wallet or address, or run an overview of the evidence held in this book.
noNodes: No nodes match this query. Inspect coverage and the frontier before drawing conclusions.
noItems: No items returned for this query.
selectDetail: Inspect exact identifiers, provenance and boundaries. Trace from a selection to refine the investigation.

graph.label: Interactive transaction and output graph
graph.help: Drag or use arrows to pan · scroll or + / − to zoom · 0 to fit · F for readable view
graph.overview: Graph overview. Click to navigate; press Enter to fit the graph.

case.title: Saved investigations
case.name: Investigation title
case.changed: The current book differs from this saved snapshot.
case.unchanged: No change in the current query result.
case.historical: Saved snapshot — rerun to see current evidence.
case.localHelp: Saved locally, with its exact query and evidence snapshot.

acquire.title: Acquire missing chain evidence
acquire.description: This separate action contacts the backend you choose. It can reveal requested transaction IDs and connected graph relationships to that backend. Preview the request budget before fetching.
acquire.none: No configured chain backend is available. Add one under Connections.
acquire.subject: Acquisition starting point
acquire.finished: Fetched {{count}} transactions in {{requests}} requests. Rerun the investigation to include them.
acquire.incomplete: Acquisition ended with an unresolved frontier.
acquire.planChanged: Inputs changed. Preview a new plan before fetching.
acquire.genesis: Genesis hash pin (required for custom networks)

entropyPanel.description: Count feasible input/output partitions under an explicit model. This is conditional ambiguity, not an ownership probability or a privacy grade.
entropyPanel.subject: Transaction to analyze
entropyPanel.domainRequired: Choose the chain and network. The current reference does not identify one observed transaction domain uniquely.
entropyPanel.unsupported: Joint-payment structures such as Payjoin are not represented by the partition model.
entropyPanel.inputsChanged: Inputs changed. Compute again to see a result for this subject, domain and budget.

labels.title: Local evidence labels
labels.subject: Exact subject
labels.label: Label
labels.scope: Labels describe exact subjects. They do not grant custody or spread through a cluster.

error: The operation could not be completed.
assistantPrompt: Investigate the local chain evidence for subject {{subject}} using the saved query {{query}}. The visible snapshot is {{snapshot}}. Distinguish physical facts, reviewed custody, ownership hypotheses and missing coverage. Use local chain-analysis tools; ask before acquiring evidence or changing the book.
refreshFailed: Refresh failed. These are the previous results; they do not reflect a successful new investigation.
queryChanged: Controls changed. The graph still shows the last executed query; run again to apply them.
exposureHelp: Local source-backed labels and their observed connectivity. Contact does not prove a payment, taint or common ownership.

workbench.scenarioHelp: Protocol names describe the scenario; they do not detect a protocol or infer its fees. Participant limits use exact whole-satoshi amounts in msat (1 sat = 1,000 msat).
workbench.exactMsat: Enter nonnegative whole-satoshi amounts as msat, without separators.
workbench.comparisonHelp: Exact fractions compare conditional link counts within the same subject, observer and snapshot. They are not wallet ownership probabilities.
workbench.incomparable: These results cannot be compared: both must be exact and belong to the same subject, observer and snapshot.
workbench.conditionalLinks: Counts describe membership in feasible financial-flow groups under the stated model. A full count is conditional on those assumptions, never proof of ownership.
workbench.pickerUnavailable: File selection is available in the desktop app or connected local preview.
workbench.inputsChanged: Inputs changed. Analyze again to review the current selection.

psbt.title: Inspect a transaction before signing
psbt.help: Inspect supplied UTXOs, transaction characteristics and proposal changes locally. No signature or broadcast is performed.
psbt.noFile: Choose a local PSBT file. Assistant requests use an opaque source reference; remote providers receive a curated projection.
psbt.networkHelp: The network is selected by you; scripts do not encode it. This check does not verify chain membership or whether inputs are unspent.
psbt.validationHelp: Structurally valid does not mean signatures, ownership, network or unspentness were verified. Missing amounts stay unknown.
psbt.assistantPrompt: Inspect the currently selected local PSBT source references and explicit comparison constraints: {{selection}}. Use the PSBT tools to analyze both sources and compare when an after_token is present. If current_comparison_available is false, compute a fresh comparison; an entropy_job_id refers to its submitted historical computation. Explain missing UTXO evidence, features, changes and limitations. Do not sign or broadcast.

datasets.title: Local attribution datasets
datasets.help: Import versioned source claims and inspect exact matches. Labels remain attributed claims; they do not establish ownership, taint or accounting authority.
datasets.noFile: Select a local CSV or JSONL attribution file.
datasets.visibilityHelp: Public makes these claims available to the public observer model; it does not publish or upload the file.
datasets.formatHelp: Generic rows use subject, label and optional category. Source-specific adapters preserve their attribution as claims. Preview validates the entire file.
datasets.previewChanged: Source or manifest changed. Validate a fresh preview before importing.
datasets.confirmHelp: Confirm this exact content hash and manifest. A replacement activates only after the full import succeeds.
datasets.queryHelp: Search an exact chain subject, or select a dataset and search its exact entity label. No result does not establish absence elsewhere.
datasets.subject: Exact subject
datasets.label: Exact label
datasets.noMatch: No matching claims in this scoped lookup.
datasets.discardHelp: Remove the stored rows of this incomplete import. Completed dataset versions stay available.
datasets.assistantDataset: Inspect local attribution dataset {{id}} using dataset tools. Explain provenance, version, visibility and limitations. Labels remain sourced claims, not ownership or taint evidence.
datasets.assistantSource: Help inspect the selected local attribution source using opaque token {{token}}. Use an on-device provider for file preview/import. Require validated content and explicit consent before importing; do not fetch external data.
